name: American Airlines
max_carrier_dimensions: Soft-sided (recommended): 18 x 11 x 11 in (46 x 28 x 28 cm); hard-sided mainline: 19 x 13 x 9 in; hard-sided American Eagle: 16 x 12 x 8 in
max_combined_weight: 20 lb (9.07 kg) pet + carrier on A321T premium cabins; checked kennel max 100 lb (45 kg) combined. No general in-cabin limit stated.

fees.route: Carry-on: U.S., Canada, Mexico, Central America, Caribbean

checked_or_cargo: Checked pets only for active-duty U.S. Military and State Department Foreign Service on official orders. Others: American Airlines Cargo (PetEmbark).
banned_breeds: Checked: brachycephalic cats (e.g. Burmese, Persian, Himalayan, Exotic Shorthair) and brachycephalic dogs (e.g. Boxer, Bulldog, Pug, Shih Tzu, Pit Bull, Mastiff, and more).
banned_routes: No carry-on pets to/from Hawaii, Jamaica, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Uruguay, or on trans-Atlantic and trans-Pacific trips.
service_animal_note: Fully-trained service dogs fly in the cabin at no charge if they meet requirements.
notes: Carry-on pets: max 20 carriers per flight on most mainline aircraft; no dogs as carry-on from CDC high-risk rabies countries.
